page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with two notes in the left margin. Running head at top, page number "62" at top left. No headings, no catchword, no signature.
page.running_head: De Agro Fris. inter Lavic. & Amas.

main_text.p: ac legem subirecivitas hæc nostra multo tempore recusavit. Nec exemplis destituebatur aliarum civitatum liberarum, quæ & præsectos hujuscemodi à vicinis reciperent Principibus, & tamen iisdem jurejurando, ut subditæ, se non obligarent. Et cum ipsa in Frisiæ solo,ac Frisici juris esset, relictâ Fœdus Anseati-cum.libertate gentis alienigenis dominis se subijcere tergiversabatur. Et quamvis mussarent sæpèEpiscopi,præ-sertim si qui ingeniis erant ambitiosis, tamen ad vim descendere ob hanc causam aufi non sunt. Nam creverant jam opes civitatis, & fœderum pactis de tuendâ libertate cum vicinis firmabantur. Accedebat, quòd in societatem fœderis Anseatici, cujus tum & magnum robur, & non vilis autoritas, & prompta auxilia erant, civitas jamdudum esset cooptata, nec abjectam conditionem in sociarum civitatum ordine teneret. Quæ cum sic haberent, quamquam Florentius Episc. VI-trajecti-nus. [?]Florentius episco-pus, familiâ Wevelichovius, vir sapiens & industrius, à Wenceslao Cæsare diploma obtinuisset signatum anno M. CCC. LXXXII, ipsis Calend. Maij, quo di-plomate

page.notes: The left-margin notes are small italic; "Florentius Episc. VI-trajecti-nus" is read only in part and is doubtful. The printed page number and running head are as set; long s has been normalised to s throughout. The final word "plomate" stands alone on the last line, carried over from "di-", and is treated as the end of the paragraph.
